frame.grid.note: 64x64 luminance grid; compared with a MEASURED TOLERANCE, never byte-wise, because llvmpipe is not bit-reproducible across runs (bead oo-ae9). Deliberately NOT part of state.json.

determinism_notes.cast_pinned: mission.runScreen's `model` is given in LITERAL [shipKey] form ([oolite_shader_test_suite_13]). A BARE role would be a RANROT draw (Universe.m:4008 -> :3948 -> OOShipRegistry.m:276-279) whose position depends on frames burned earlier, so a fixed seed does NOT fix the cast (bead oo-izi). OOShipRegistry.m:1229 registers the [key] form at probability 1.0, so no draw is made.
determinism_notes.detail_level_pinned: debugConsole.detailLevel is written from the spec and READ BACK. It selects between the shader and fixed-function material paths and the fixture ships parallel entry sets for each.
determinism_notes.no_spin: spinModel=false. makeDemoShipWithRole:spinning: (Universe.m:5827-5834) sets demoRate=1.0 when spinning and ShipEntity.m:2337-2342 then derives the model's orientation from [UNIVERSE getTime] - a wall-clock rotation that would put a different frame on screen every run.

frame_control.control_method: Three arms, all produced by THIS scenario's own code (--no-model / --empty-stage / --no-oxp write the frame grid before the evidence gate, so a REFUSED run still yields its frame). The narrow arm is --no-model: the SAME expansion staged, the SAME backdrop, the SAME screen, the SAME ticks - the ONLY variable is whether a material-bearing model is drawn. Its texture-upload list independently records the backdrop alone, the two oolite_shader_test_suite_* maps never decoded, which is the non-graphical confirmation.
frame_control.tolerance_source: tests/golden/frame_hash.py derive_tolerance() over tests/golden/calibration.json (bead oo-ae9; noise floor 0.002541, weakest real signal 0.007541). USED AS MEASURED, never adjusted.
frame_control.verdict: MATERIALS DO MOVE THE FRAME HASH, far beyond the instrument's noise. Two independent launches of the identical scene differ by 0.000514 (0.12x tolerance); removing ONLY the material-bearing model, with everything else held constant, moves the frame 0.072411 (16.54x) - a 141-fold separation between noise and signal attributable to the MATERIAL MAPS specifically rather than to the expansion's presence. Removing the expansion entirely moves it 0.210506 (48.09x). --no-oxp and --empty-stage agree with each other to 0.001715 (0.39x, WITHIN tolerance), which is the expected cross-check: both render the same expansion-less screen.

landing_rehearsal.note: Both the runner and the offline tests search goldens/windows-x64/008-material-test-suite/ FIRST and fall back to tests/golden/pending/008-material-test-suite/, so landing is a pure `git mv` with no code change - the same shape scenarios 010 and 012 use. See LANDING.md.

manifest_state.decision: ALLOW-LIST NOTHING. Bead oo-kcrw classified 'the five in-tree legacy test-oxps' as NOMANIF; there are SIX and this is the sixth - Material Test Suite.oxp SHIPS a manifest.plist, verified on disk against all six and confirmed by a real launch whose 13452-byte Latest.log contained ZERO [oxp-standards.error] lines while [searchPaths.dumpAll] named the staged copy. So allowed_oxp_standards_errors=0 with an EMPTY allow-list: any such line fails the run. This is STRICTER than 010/012's exact-count allowance, not weaker. No manifest is staged or removed - fabricating or deleting fixture content would falsify the thing under test.

stability.note: 10/10 runs exited 0 and wrote a BYTE-IDENTICAL dump; the blessed state.json has that same digest. stdout+stderr were captured for EVERY run regardless of exit code and each run was classified by what it PRODUCED (DUMPED/REFUSED/BROKEN), never filtered on returncode. The 10 frame grids are all distinct, as expected: llvmpipe is not bit-reproducible, which is why the grid is compared with the measured tolerance and is NOT in state.json. Harness: tools/oo-qd6-stability.sh.
